description: This file defines the NoteMapper class responsible for mapping between Note domain objects and various Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) such as CreateNoteRequest, UpdateNoteRequest, and NoteResponse. It facilitates the conversion necessary for API communication, adhering to specified requirements for entity-DTO mapping.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: Component class responsible for converting between Note domain model and various Note DTOs for API operations.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a CreateNoteRequest DTO into a Note entity, assigning the owner ID.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing Note entity based on data from an UpdateNoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity into a NoteResponse DTO for API response payloads.

calls: new NoteResponse(note.getId(), note.getTitle(), note.getContent(), note.getOwnerId(), note.getCreatedAt(), note.getUpdatedAt())
